# ChurchCRM 7.8.4 Release Notes

ChurchCRM 7.8.4 focuses on making everyday ministry tasks faster and more intuitive—from reviewing year-end giving and managing deposits to navigating on phones and tablets, coordinating volunteers, and sending family communications.

---

## ⚠️ Important Guidance Before You Upgrade

Please keep these workflow changes in mind when updating:

* **Legacy Volunteer Opportunities Retired:** The older Volunteer Opportunities (V1) tool is now hidden for churches that aren't actively using it. If your church still has legacy data, ChurchCRM will display a clear warning and guide you through converting it to the modern Volunteer Management experience.
* **Stricter Member Portal Sign-In & Verification:** Family verification emails now direct members straight to the Member Portal with clearer instructions, and member sign-in now requires exact email matching to keep household accounts secure.
* **Database Version Check:** The setup and upgrade wizard now stops early if your server is running an unsupported legacy database (such as MariaDB 10.0), preventing partial or failed upgrades.

---

## 💰 Finance, Giving & Stewardship Workflows

* **Fiscal-Year Giving & Pledge Insights:** View a clear breakdown of funds by fiscal year right on the Finance Dashboard, browse available fiscal years on the Year-End Giving page, and run a new **Fiscal-Year Pledge Comparison Report** to track giving trends over time.
* **Sample Giving Statement Preview:** Preview how your giving statement PDFs look using fictional sample data before generating real statements for your congregation.
* **Faster Payment & Check Entry:** Record check payments without needing a check number when it isn't required, and find families faster when looking up envelope numbers during payment entry.
* **Mobile-Friendly Deposit Charts:** The deposit editor funds chart now collapses neatly on smaller screens, and deposit dashboard charts display dates in proper chronological order.
* **Organized Statement Settings:** Statement Settings have moved under **Finance Admin**, keeping all giving configuration in one predictable place.

---

## 📱 Navigation, Mobile & Everyday Usability

* **Compact Icon Sidebar & Better Mobile Menus:** Keep navigation within easy reach on desktop with a collapsible icon sidebar that centers your workspace, while tablet and phone menus now open smoothly and stay reliably in view.
* **Clean, Consistent Popups & Notifications:** Replaced browser popups with clean, modern confirmations and toast notifications across the system.
* **Custom Logo Polish on Sign-In:** When your church uploads a custom logo, the redundant church name text is hidden on the login screen for a cleaner welcome.
* **Faster Large Carts & Maps:** Loading large member carts is noticeably faster, and storing individual coordinates means group and cart maps load right away without repeatedly looking up addresses.
* **Accurate Mailing Labels:** Inactive member records are now automatically excluded when generating mailing labels.

---

## 📧 Communication & Member Engagement

* **Member Portal Verification Links:** Family verification emails now link directly into the Member Portal with clearer step-by-step instructions for households.
* **Unified Event Emailing:** Clicking "Email All" from an event now opens the shared email composer, giving you the same reliable queue, formatting, and history tracking as other congregational messages.
* **Church Name in 2FA Apps:** Setting up two-factor authentication now displays your church's name inside authenticator apps, making it easy to tell accounts apart.

---

## 📅 Calendar, Dates & Global Localization

* **No Duplicate Calendar Events:** Events pinned to multiple calendars now appear once rather than cluttering your view.
* **Consistent Date Formats & Time Zones:** Dates across the app follow your church's configured date-picker format, CSV exports respect your church's

detail.readme:
# ChurchCRM

ChurchCRM helps churches organize people and families, groups, events, attendance, giving, volunteers, and reports in one place.

**Free. No subscription. Your data is yours.**

ChurchCRM is open-source and self-hosted, so a church can choose where its information runs and how it is managed.

[![Software License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-brightgreen.svg)](LICENSE)
[![GitHub All Releases](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/ChurchCRM/CRM/total?color=blue&logo=github)](https://github.com/ChurchCRM/CRM/releases)
[![Latest Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/churchcrm/crm?label=Latest%20Release)](https://github.com/ChurchCRM/CRM/releases/latest)
[![Latest Release Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/ChurchCRM/CRM/latest/total?label=latest%20downloads&color=green)](https://github.com/ChurchCRM/CRM/releases/latest)

## Try it or install it

See the real product before you decide:

- **[Try the live demo](https://churchcrm.io/demo.html?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=github_content&utm_content=crm_readme_demo)** — Softaculous creates a private, temporary ChurchCRM instance for you. It expires automatically; use fictional data only.
- **[Install ChurchCRM](https://churchcrm.io/install.html?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=github_content&utm_content=crm_readme_install)** — run it on your own hosting with the official installation guidance.
- **[Run it with Docker](https://docs.churchcrm.io/installation/docker)** — official `churchcrm/crm` images on Docker Hub, built for amd64 and arm64 from each stable release.
- **[Read the documentation](https://docs.churchcrm.io/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=github_content&utm_content=crm_readme_docs)** — installation, configuration, administration, and user guides.

## What churches use it for

ChurchCRM supports real church workflows, including:

**People & families → Groups → Events & attendance → Giving & financial tracking → Volunteers → Reports**

## 🚀 Development quick start

If you're new to ChurchCRM, start with our **[Documentation](https://docs.churchcrm.io/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=github_content&utm_content=crm_readme_docs_start)**.
You'll find step-by-step installation instructions, configuration notes, and user guides there.

Quick start: see the "Quick Start" section in the Documentation for a fast setup.

For core development setup, architecture, builds, and testing, see [DEVELOPING.md](DEVELOPING.md).

## 🌐 Localization Support

ChurchCRM currently lists **49 supported locales**. Translation coverage varies by locale; see the generated audit report for the current status.

Translations live in this repo (`src/locale/i18n/`). To fix or add translations for your language, open a pull request; see [Translate](CONTRIBUTING.md#translate).

See the latest translation status and audit report: [locale/poeditor-audit.md](locale/poeditor-audit.md).

## 💡 Contributing

We welcome contributions from everyone! Whether it's bug reports, feature requests, or code contributions, your input is invaluable.

[See the contribution guidelines](CONTRIBUTING.md) for how to file issues and submit pull requests.

- Quick contributions: fork the repository, create a feature branch, run the test suite, and open a pull request; see CONTRIBUTING.md for details.

[![GitHub contributors](https://img.shields.io/github/contributors/churchcrm/crm.svg)](https://github.com/ChurchCRM/CRM/graphs/contributors)
[![Join the chat at Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-ChurchCRM-5865F2?logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/tuWyFzj3Nj)

## 📚 Documentation

Our [Documentation](https://docs.churchcrm.io/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=github_content&utm_content=crm_readme_docs_resource) is your go-to resource for understanding ChurchCRM.
If you notice anything missing or unclear, feel free to open an issue or submit a pull request.

## 🤝 Community

Join our [Discord community](https://discord.gg/tuWyFzj3Nj) to connect with other users, ask questions, and share your experiences.
We believe in the power of a supportive community!

## 🙏 Thank You

A heartfelt thank you to all our contributors, past and present. Your efforts make ChurchCRM better with every release.
